about: The change register (lib/change-register.ts). One entry per batch that reached production: the pages it touched as path prefixes ('/' alone is the homepage, a trailing '/' means everything under it), the one metric it should move (conv:<event> from the weekly snapshots, gsc:clicks from data/gsc, tally:<field> from the booking tally, or none), and the day to read it, 28 days on. Add an entry when a change ships; node scripts/change-readout.mjs reads them out and the monthly email prints the ones that are due.

changes.note: Booking mail names the counsellor and books her calendar; the practice is told who did not book after a consultation. No page; read site-wide.
The monthly funnel report joins consultations, paid sessions and messages. Measurement only.
/book reads two weeks of times, says it is online only, and states the session fee. The calendar exists only on /book and the portal, so the untouched comparison is the portal.
Fees from the catalogue, one booking rule, condition sections on the service they book into.
Who you would see on service, audience and city pages; city hubs answer cost and office. Shares its pages with services, so the two cannot be told apart.
Language pages book with a counsellor who speaks the language and offers the service.
Insurance gate on Alberta and Canada-wide reach, referral pages from the roster, privacy and regulation corrections.
Redirects in one list without chains, IndexNow ping, one date per page, GSC pull, no evening promises. Mostly site-wide; the place pages are the touched set.
Counsellor titles lead with the person and her language, machine files list only accepting counsellors, one BreadcrumbList per page.
Cliniko-confirmed bookings, landing and button credit, email clicks, retention, the 8-week table, Search Console on /admin, this register. Measurement only.
